　Unit-00, support them both」

stage0041_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:

「All units, attack!

　If only we had one more unit...」

「Just so you know, this Unit-02
　is on a whole different level than your EVAs」

stage0041_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:

　a development prototype and a test type!
　But this Unit-02 is different!」

stage0041_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アスカ$$
「This is the real deal, the world's
　first true Evangelion built for actual combat!
　A production model!」

「Then, Captain... your orders.」

stage0041_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:

stage0041_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アスカ$$

stage0041_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Can't let the new girl outdo us!

stage0041_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「How plucky!

stage0041_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$

「The second he finds out it's a pretty

stage0041_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't say that.
　It's just a man's nature.」

stage0041_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, everyone.

stage0041_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:

$$ユノハ$$
（$$シンジ$$... you're worried about $$ジン$$, aren't you...）

stage0041_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Still doing what needs to be done...
　You've grown.）

stage0041_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ボス$$
「Nice parting shot.
　He's really getting the hang of playing the loser.」

stage0041_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I won't think about $$ジン$$ right now...
　I need to focus on what's ahead of me.）

stage0041_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（And I thought we'd finally become friends...!）

stage0041_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What is this...
　Fighting this thing called an Angel makes me
　feel scared, yet strangely nostalgic...）

stage0041_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アマタ$$
（But one thing I'm sure of is
　that I can't let this thing through...!）

stage0041_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Fighting Angels is my duty...
　I'll fight alongside Ikari...）

stage0041_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Unlucky for you...!
　If you'd shown up a little sooner,
　you wouldn't have had to fight me...!」

stage0041_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But showing up here was your bad luck!
　You'll be my and Unit-02's punching bag!」

stage0041_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I heard $c fights enemies
　other than Angels too, but I didn't think
　I'd run into one right after arriving in Japan...!」

stage0041_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「But I won't lose...!
　No matter who shows up, me and Unit-02
　are going to win, no matter what!」

stage0041_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Same old opportunist, $$ブロッケン$$!
　And this time you went after $$シンジ$$
　and the others while we weren't around!」

stage0041_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Silence!
　All that matters in battle is winning!」

stage0041_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is that so!
　Then don't complain when you lose to us!」

stage0041_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm getting sick of your parting shots too!」

stage0041_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$マデューカス$$, everyone.
　Our enemy is terrorist remnants plotting
　world conquest, and a being that would destroy the world.」

stage0041_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There's no need to hold back.
　We'll eliminate the target with all our strength.」

stage0041_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, commence battle...!
　Show them who rules these seas!」

stage0041_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「You think a mere submarine can beat
　the $$飛行要塞グール$$!」

stage0041_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Baseless confidence...
　You seem like the type least suited to command.」

stage0041_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then let us show him
　just how much his own view of things
　is built on convenient, wishful thinking.」

stage0041_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Grr, you little brat!
　Frankly, I've fundamentally never cared
　for submariners in the first place!」

stage0041_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「How convenient.
　I have no wish to be liked by you either.」

stage0041_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And you, who underestimated the strength
　of my $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, will pay the price.」

stage0041_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's the mission of the woman you scorned
　as a little girl... the captain of this ship.」
